cp21:1.1: Yadā ahaṃ amitayaso rājaputto Yudhañjayo ussāvabinduṃ suriyātape patitaṃ disvāna saṃvijiṃ. || ||
cp21:2.1: Tañ-ñevādhipatiṃ katvā saṃvegam- anubrūhayiṃ mātāpitu ca vanditvā pabbajjam-anuyāc' ahaṃ. || ||
cp21:3.1: Yācanti maṃ pañjalikā sanegamā saraṭṭhakā: ajj' eva putta paṭipajja iddhaṃ phītaṃ mahāmahiṃ. || ||
cp21:4.1: Sarājake sah' orodhe sanegame saraṭṭhake karuṇaṃ paridevante anapekkho pariccajiṃ. || ||
cp21:5.1: Kevalaṃ paṭhavīrajjaṃ ñātiparijanaṃ yasaṃ cajamāno na cintesiṃ bodhiyā-yeva kāraṇā. || ||
cp21:6.1: Mātā pitā na me dessā na pi me dessaṃ mahāyasaṃ sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā rajjaṃ pariccajin-ti. || ||
